topPRs.title: fix: repair first-run activation, plugin staging, and recovery validation
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
First-run activation persists the selected model and account routing through readiness, chat and cold restart. Failed activation restores still-owned durable and live configuration without overwriting concurrent updates. Busy admission rejects before persistence. Plugin staging preserves source entries and dependency identities, relocates Windows junctions before publication, and builds runtime exports in dependency order.

Background evaluation now finishes durably before scenario fixtures yield ownership. Complete visible entity names and IDs have stable ordering, so hidden display-name metadata cannot invalidate an unchanged evaluator request. Recovery control output stays out of visible responses while complete model inputs and recordings remain intact. Selected UI controls retain their selected state and readable nested text, pipeline badges use the canonical design variant, and Accounts actions wrap within mobile cards.

The Accounts inventory route shares one freshly validated credential snapshot across provider projections, reducing a measured request from 29 full reads to 2 including the expiry sweep. It preserves existing selection policies and older host compatibility; corrupt storage still fails explicitly. The branch also repairs deterministic scenario contracts and CI prerequisite/import/timer failures without weakening their behavioral assertions.

Current head: `7321244a200285498ff831164f4918250d54407b`, rebased onto `d07f6dc2e2271ab8e4ebc2fef2cf389e40dabb39`. Normal frozen installation, the complete root verification, and all 99 combined scenarios passed with Bun 1.3.14 and Node 24.15.0. The browser fixture now advances its real workspace tab only after the real action emits a nonmatching URL poll; it no longer races a 500 ms timer. Production polling and the at-least-two-polls assertion remain unchanged.

Previous head `2ea08dc` passed PR admission and Windows runtime qualification. Its full CI first attempt failed one real Worker Twilio assertion (expected configuration HTTP 503, received HTTP 500); an explicit failed-job rerun now passes all full CI jobs. The same source passes fresh local Worker/PGlite qualification: all 18 cloud API E2E files, 517 passes, zero failures, 18 explicit skips. This does not explain or erase the hosted failure. Final selected-state UI and actual activation/restart HTTP qualification are tracked separately below.

| Contract | Evidence and remaining validation |
| --- | --- |
| Final installation and repository gates | PASS at `7321244a`: normal frozen install and complete root verification, including package types/lint and repository audits. Clean committed source retained. |
| Account inventory | Component `ca4e5c63`: 69 owner tests pass, real encrypted-store/HTTP parity and freshness checks pass, and restoring original production reproduces the 29-versus-2 read failure. Real browser flow passes 49 assertions with 26 captures. Measured two-account GET falls from 2,251 to 239 ms; hosted timeout causation remains provisional until the final hosted rerun. Final combined route and pool tests pass (27 route and 69 pool tests); the real API/pool/disk hosted Accounts flow passes at `2ea08dc`. |
| Activation and cold restart | Historical `5c16100b` proof runs the real host with a synthetic provider: all 11 model pins, account/routing, both replies and personal-assistant survive cold restart; owned processes and ports are released. The `2ea08dc` rerun failed when personal-assistant staging exceeded the unchanged watchdog. The final `7321244a` run passes all actual HTTP activation and cold-restart assertions in 115.958 seconds with that same watchdog; owned ports and process groups are released. The earlier failure remains recorded without an established cause. This is not live-provider or native inference proof. |
| Live evaluator | Historical `5c16100b`: one real Cerebras request persists the colleague relationship with exact source IDs/revision after the controlled hidden-metadata transition; no pending jobs remain and proxy/process cleanup is verified. Original requests, responses, SQL evidence and failed iterations are retained. |
| Scenario fixtures | `58cc489b`: all 99 combined scenarios pass (42 deterministic, 8 corpus, 15 orchestrator, 34 LifeOps). The subsequent two-import repair additionally passes the canonical PA Vitest loader (4 tests), LifeOps (34), focused types and lint. Final `7321244a` combined rerun passes all 99 scenarios (42 + 8 + 15 + 34), with no failures or skips. |
| Retry and scanner tests | Retry component `6e4f3674`: actual retry loop/sleep tested across controlled timer boundaries; removing the awaited sleep fails the negative control; both files pass 58 tests. Scanner component `502e7556`: 50 focused tests pass and a reconstructed superlinear implementation fails the unchanged growth limit. Production retry/scanner behavior is unchanged. |
| Windows staging | [Component `9ab7ca24` qualification](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/35283589137) passes: non-admin identity, actual directory-symlink EPERM, 12 real dependency/junction tests and exact registry restoration. It establishes and restores the hosted prerequisite rather than replacing the EPERM assertion. Combined `2ea08dc` Windows runtime qualification passes; subsequent source changes are upstream tests and the browser scenario fixture. Cleanup succeeded; no separate post-cleanup user/process enumeration is claimed. |
| Visual acceptance | Canonical audit at `58cc489b` passes 230/230; all 23 flagged originals and 28 affected-view originals were reviewed. Production rendering is unchanged through the current head; upstream UI deltas are test files only. Family supplement passes 8/8 with 82 originals reviewed. Mobile Accounts correction reproduces overflow at 390/320 widths before the fix and passes afterward. Final app supplement: 7 pass/7 fail; Storybook supplement: 16 pass/20 fail. All 20 Storybook failures and four app failures report unresolved effective background in the external contrast probe; Trigger Prompt setup omitted selection on a Workflow-default form. Corrected setup/probe and original-capture review remain pending; these supplemental checks are not claimed passing. Current Storybook build and required IDs are verified. |
| Cloud startup | Root-owned cloud scripts now receive their required dotenv dependency (also merged upstream in #31703). An isolated Node consumer fails without the root dependency and passes with it, including actual environment-file precedence. Hosted scripts pass at `2ea08dc`. Full local cloud API E2E passes 517 tests with 18 explicit skips; the hosted smoke Twilio 500 remains under investigation. |

The previous [58cc full CI run](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/35281353131) failed in cloud startup/scripts, Accounts latency, the PA Vitest import and retry wall-clock timing. Each failure has a reviewed repair in this head. Those old checks remain failures; they are not relabeled as passing.

Reviewed historical evidence is downloadable with SHA-256 manifests: [live evaluator and HTTP archive](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31614-5c161-runtime-http.tar.gz) ([manifest](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31614-5c161-runtime-http-manifest.json)); [58cc validation and retained failures archive](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31614-58cc-validation.tar.gz) ([manifest](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31614-58cc-validation-manifest.json)). The 60-workflow consolidation remains intact. This PR does not establish the broader performance targets; comparable cold/warm and three completed post-change measurements remain required for the 40% job-minute and 30% wall-time targets.

Tracks #31522, #31533, #31535, #31558, #31158, #31579, #31584, #31585, #31587, #31589, #31593, #31595, #31596, #31599, #31646, #31662, #31677, #31679, #31681, #31691, #31692, #31695 and #24104. #31581 receives diagnostics only and stays open: its historical intermittent 500 is unexplained. Supersede #31159 only after verified delivery.

topPRs.title: fix: retain interpretation context and defer planning providers
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Stage 1 could reply without authorized cross-room history, pending choices or bot-loop evidence while receiving unrelated provider context. This change admits the evidence needed to interpret a message, defers domain inventories and widget grammar to planning/completion, and keeps context ownership consistent through caching, recovery and restoration.

- Explicit provider selections cannot be broadened by hooks or cached planner state. The selection participates in cache and concurrent-composition identity.
- Cross-room fallback is suppressed only when the dedicated provider actually participates. Identity/disclosure gates remain intact; failures are unavailable states rather than empty successful history. Standalone MEMORY_SEARCH children remain discoverable.
- Planning/completion have an explicit phase independent of tool presence. Opted-in widget hosts advertise only routing in Stage 1 and compose requested controls later; pending acknowledgments cannot finish the turn. Default host widget registration is unchanged.
- Progressive discovery uses the authorized catalog independently of the routed slice. Wrong or unresolved action hints cannot hide other permitted families; an empty denied catalog does not trigger implicit discovery.
- Direct-human IGNORE decisions can receive one model review after context reads and earlier repairs. Contradictory STOP/IGNORE plus pending-work declarations receive bounded reconciliation and fail before effects if still contradictory. Valid silence and stop decisions remain available.
- Context reads retain the complete previous decision as untrusted model output, preserving pending-work reasoning without treating routing descriptions as tool availability. Same-response context-restoration reads union their valid scopes and reauthorize once; malformed batches and later repeated restoration reject without effects.

No stored history, tool receipt or original model input is summarized or truncated. Existing persona compaction and the Personal-crisis rule removal on develop are preserved. Connector-envelope wording is handled separately under #31745.

Closes #31734.

Validation:
- Source revision `1ce5a3abc89c44c7d5788dba6d5df79404f8cfc2`: pinned install; 778 core tests in 20 files; 86 agent tests in 7 files; three real adapter schema-wire tests; 26 prompt tests; secret checks; and complete root `bun run verify` passed (923.79 seconds).
- Live Cerebras run13 with local 384-dimensional embeddings and a guard rejecting remote embedding endpoints passed all five strict cases: greeting (864ms), exact calendar-card markup with no domain actions (1,568ms), cross-room violet correction (1,872ms), courier choice (517ms), and two actual read-only tools (3,678ms). These are individual observations, not a speedup benchmark.
- Exact UTF-8 SHA-256 result and visible final answer matched `48ee1f1b8e2c22a2e86988cfcb32ea2753dedc2734b571af979aeb32fc836005`; actual HTTPS fetch returned Example Domain. An internal model thought misquoted the hash; the receipt and delivered result were correct, and the original is preserved.
- Earlier failures remain recorded, including routing/task loss, duplicate restoration, incidental widget actions and an incorrectly copied final hash. They drove concrete regression fixes; no uniform model-compliance claim is made.
- Integration revision `19ccd1c78ac2f3ef42df7c3e66f1dbb3f6a9ca63` merges only upstream calendar tests and HMR configuration. Core/agent/prompts/model-adapter source is byte-identical to qualified 1ce5a3. Pinned install, 116 changed calendar tests across five files, HMR configuration discovery, guide parity, focused-test integrity and lane membership all passed.
- Exact integrated-head hosted run35462622133 passed all five jobs at 19ccd1c. Normal merge commit: `7986f6f89d2eb34d721f5c8fb4c6cca437fc60ec` (2026-09-19 19:34:26 UTC). Prior run35412639960 also passed at a6b62e. Earlier broad agent tests had five FFmpeg failures with missing Homebrew libx265.216.dylib; no complete unrelated integration-suite pass is claimed.

No production connector conversation or deployment was used. All live history and user requests are synthetic fixtures. Complete context exports are public below; transport headers and credentials were never captured. The capsule includes full validation logs, integration receipts, a SHA-256 manifest, and all final and retained-failure contexts/results. All 25 archive entries and five published assets were downloaded and byte-compared with the local originals. Credential-value and common-secret scans passed. Every model-facing string and returned content/tool-call string was verified present in each regenerated readable export (7,336 checks across 51 model calls).

Real-LLM trajectory: [Complete final run13 model input/output, tools and results](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31736-final-run13-context.md). Retained failures: [run11 complete context](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31736-retained-failure-run11-context.md), [run12 complete context](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31736-retained-failure-run12-context.md). These are actual Cerebras responses, not simulated model outputs. Complete runtime result records for every run are also in the capsule.

topPRs.title: test(cloud): consolidate billing transactions and cron coverage
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Billing tests repeated the same parser, database setup, lifecycle and cron outcomes across multiple suites. This removes four redundant files and consolidates those behaviors into existing PGlite transaction and receipt flows: 761 net lines removed across 15 test files, with no production changes or new harness.

The retained tests exercise stored invalid balances, mutation rejection without ledger changes, late-write rollback, settlement/replay, reactivation and deletion authority, durable cron receipts and response sanitization. Thin route tests keep HTTP/error mapping; real receipt/full-flow tests own durable outcomes. Separate Bun processes preserve module-mock isolation. Existing PostgreSQL concurrency/precision coverage remains unchanged.

Closes #31674, closes #31675, closes #31678, closes #31680, closes #31684, closes #31685.

Validation on the PR branch (based directly on develop 47216363f5):

- Fresh worktree `bun install --frozen-lockfile`: passed, including local native embedding verification; lockfile unchanged.
- Eight changed/adjacent shared suites: 100 tests, 481 assertions passed.
- Cron suites in separate Bun processes: 11 route + 12 receipt + 5 full-flow tests passed.
- Both cloud packages' typecheck and read-only lint pass through full root `bun run verify`: 373/373 tasks, zero cache hits, and all subsequent audits pass. API router contract and Worker bundle dry run pass. Shared lint has 11 existing warnings; API lint has no diagnostics.
- Initial standalone package typechecks encountered absent login declarations immediately after install. The normal root graph built login and both package checks then passed; no source workaround was added.
- `git diff --check` and deleted-path reference search pass. Rebase on origin/develop reports up to date. The scoped PR contains six test-only commits; no inherited refactor stack.
- Hosted CI remains pending PR creation.

Earlier family validation also used temporary parser/receipt-identity faults to show retained tests detect actual incorrect effects; those experiments preceded this delivery branch and do not substitute for its checks. PGlite proves these local transactions, not separate-session PostgreSQL or live billing-provider execution.

topPRs.title: fix(plugin-app-manager): gate privileged app mutations behind OWNER/ADMIN
topPRs.author: CW1118
topPRs.body:
<!-- Fill every visible section. Keep every evidence row visible; use N/A with a concrete reason when a row does not apply. -->

# Relates to

Fixes #27591 — `/api/apps/relaunch` bypasses the OWNER/ADMIN role gate enforced
on `/api/apps/launch`. This PR closes the whole class: every privileged
app-manager mutation now shares the same gate.

Definition of Done: full standard in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [x] This PR targets `develop` and is rebased onto the latest `origin/develop`
      with zero conflicts (`git fetch origin && git rebase origin/develop`).
- [ ] `bun install` and `bun run verify` were run after sync, or any failure is
      recorded below with the exact unrelated blocker.
- [x] A reviewer can confirm the change works without reading the code, from the
      evidence attached below.

# Sync with develop

- [x] Rebased/merged onto the latest `origin/develop`; zero conflicts
      (`ebc808e3a67fb941e29153d89fc896524d32fe3c`).
- [ ] `bun run verify` passes post-sync, or the exact unrelated blocker is
      documented in **Known gaps / failures** below.

# Risks

Low. Adds the existing `canLaunchApps(actorRole)` check to privileged routes
before they read the body or touch the app manager. OWNER/ADMIN behavior is
unchanged. The gate is the same helper `/api/apps/launch` already uses.

# Background

## What does this PR do?

The agent's outer gate admits any authenticated host session — a non-owner host
session resolves to `actorRole: USER` (`server.ts:1811-1848`) — and
`resolveBoundaryRole` maps any non-`isAuthorized` caller to `GUEST`
(`server-helpers-auth.ts:470`). Only `/api/apps/launch` checked
`canLaunchApps(actorRole)`, so a non-owner could:

- `POST /api/apps/relaunch` — stop then launch (fixed in the first commit),
- `POST /api/apps/install` — install a plugin (code execution),
- `POST /api/apps/load-from-directory` — load apps from an arbitrary directory,
- `POST /api/apps/create` — invoke the APP create action,
- `POST /api/apps/stop` and `POST /api/apps/runs/:runId/stop` — stop apps,
- `PUT /api/apps/permissions/:slug` — change app permission grants.

All of these now return 403 unless the actor is OWNER/ADMIN. `GET` permissions
and viewer-only run routes (attach/detach/heartbeat) are unchanged.

## What kind of change is this?

Bug fix (non-breaking) — authorization.

# Documentation changes needed?

My changes do not require a change to the project documentation.

# Testing

## Where should a reviewer start?

`plugins/plugin-app-manager/src/api/apps-routes.ts` — the gate on each
privileged branch.

## Detailed testing steps

```bash
bun run --cwd plugins/plugin-app-manager test -- apps-routes
```

The suite (52 tests) now includes:

- A deny matrix over `undefined`, `null`, `"USER"`, `"GUEST"` for install,
  stop, run-scoped stop, load-from-directory, create, and `PUT` permissions:
  each returns 403 with its route-specific message and never calls
  `appManager.stop`/`launch`.
- Allow cases for OWNER/ADMIN on stop (app and run) and install.
- The existing malformed-encoding and relative-directory boundary tests still
  run (the latter now as OWNER).

Negative control (gates removed): 24 deny cases fail, confirming the tests
discriminate the guards.

# Evidence Gate

Evidence must match the exact commit reviewed. `scripts/pr-evidence.mjs rows`
sets this marker from the live PR head; rerun it after every push.

before/after screenshots, and logs. If you did not attach them, say why.
